verdict.rationale: Jira explicitly markets cross-team dependency tracking for launches (jira-docs-8) and community feedback confirms issue linking across projects gives visibility into the 'big picture' (jira-comm-5), but many users report the tool becomes an unwieldy, admin-heavy 'forest' as it scales across teams (jira-comm-12, jira-comm-14), which undercuts smooth large-launch coordination.
